## Static Image vs. Dynamic Dashboard {background-color="#0a1628"}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.55em; letter-spacing:0.15em;">01 / WHY IT MATTERS</p>

<div style="margin-top: 60px; display:flex; gap:20px; justify-content:center;">

<div class="card" style="width:28%;">
<div class="card-icon">🖼️</div>
<div class="card-title">Screenshot (before)</div>
<div class="card-body">Frozen in time. Visitors cannot filter, drill down, or interact. Loses value immediately after publishing.</div>
</div>

<div class="card" style="width:28%;">
<div class="card-icon">⚡</div>
<div class="card-title">Embedded (after)</div>
<div class="card-body">Live data from Tableau Public. Visitors use filters, tooltips, and views — just like inside Tableau.</div>
</div>

<div class="card" style="width:28%;">
<div class="card-icon">🎯</div>
<div class="card-title">Portfolio impact</div>
<div class="card-body">Shows employers you can ship production-quality analytics, not just static demos.</div>
</div>

</div>

---

## Two Approaches in Quarto {background-color="#0a1628"}

<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.55em; letter-spacing:0.15em;">02 / HOW TO DO IT</p>

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="48%"}
```html
# experience.qmd

::: {=html}
<iframe
  src="https://public.tableau.com/
  views/USRailwayEducation
  FinalVersion/Dashboard?
  :embed=y&:showVizHome=no"
  width="100%" height="500px"
  frameborder="0">
</iframe>
:::
```
<p style="color:#2ec4b6; font-size:0.5em; margin-top:8px;">✓ Simplest method · works everywhere</p>
:::

::: {.column width="4%"}
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}
<div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; margin-top:0px;">

<div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px;">
  <div class="step-num">1</div>
  <div style="line-height:1.4;"><span style="font-weight:bold; font-size:0.65em; color:#fff;">Publish to Tableau Public</span><br><span class="step-body">Free. Your viz lives at a public URL with an embed code ready to use.</span></div>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px;">
  <div class="step-num">2</div>
  <div style="line-height:1.4;"><span style="font-weight:bold; font-size:0.65em; color:#fff;">Copy the embed URL</span><br><span class="step-body">Share → Embed Code → extract the src URL from the iframe.</span></div>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px;">
  <div class="step-num">3</div>
  <div style="line-height:1.4;"><span style="font-weight:bold; font-size:0.65em; color:#fff;">Paste into Quarto</span><br><span class="step-body">Wrap in <code>::: {=html}</code> block. Render — done!</span></div>
</div>

<div style="display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px;">
  <div class="step-num">4</div>
  <div style="line-height:1.4;"><span style="font-weight:bold; font-size:0.65em; color:#fff;">Optional: Tableau JS API</span><br><span class="step-body">Control the viz from your page: filter, highlight, listen to events.</span></div>
</div>

</div>
:::

::::

## Key Takeaways {background-color="#0a1628"}

<h2 style="font-size:1.4em; margin-bottom:0;">A portfolio that <em style="color:#e8b84b;">moves</em></h2>
<h2 style="font-size:1.4em; color:#e8b84b; font-style:italic; margin-top:4px;">is a portfolio that gets remembered.</h2>

<div class="highlight-box">
  3 lines of HTML inside a <code>::: {=html}</code> block is all it takes to turn a static screenshot into a live, interactive dashboard on your Quarto site.
</div>

<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Publish your Tableau viz to Tableau Public (free)</div>
<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Grab the embed URL from Share → Embed Code</div>
<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Drop an <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code> into your <code>.qmd</code> file inside <code>::: {=html}</code></div>
<div class="check-item">✓ &nbsp; Run <code>quarto render</code> → push to GitHub Pages</div>
